versions.summary: Schema versioning system introduction. Adds version metadata to all action schemas and establishes baseline for future change tracking.

changes.description: Added SchemaMetadata type with version, deprecated, and since fields for all action schemas.
Added optional schema_version field to validation results for debugging.
New module: SCHEMA_VERSION constant, validateSchemaVersion(), getSchemaVersion(), SchemaChangeLog types.

versions.summary: Initial schema release. Establishes baseline types for action schemas, health responses, and dispatcher validation.

changes.description: Initial release of action schema type mapping.
Initial validation result structure with valid, errors, errorMessage fields.
Health endpoint response schema with status, dispatchers, heap_used_mb, uptime_s.
Added registry_status for materials, machines, tools, alarms status tracking.
Added opus_config for Opus 4.6 feature verification.

migration_notes.1.x_to_2.x: Version 2.0.0 is backwards compatible with 1.x schemas. The schema_version field is optional in ValidationResult. No breaking changes in this release.
